name: Sensor Ghost
label: Dischord
lede: A no-wave trio built from Puff Pieces, Antelope, Weed Tree and Light Beams veterans, cut twice at Inner Ear with Ian MacKaye and Don Zientara, and pressed on translucent yellow vinyl as Dischord No. 198.

eras.title: Three lifers, one skewed trio
eras.text: Sensor Ghost came out of a D.C. underground that never stopped after the hardcore years: players from Puff Pieces, Antelope, Weed Tree, Light Beams, Vertebrates, Stigmatics and The Cornel West Theory. Dischord frames them as heirs to the city's freaked-out, iconoclastic side, the no-wave end of D.C. punk rather than the fast end.

years.cap: Sensor Ghost: Mike Andre, Amanda Huron, Sam Lavine
q: Known to leave listeners in a discombobulated trance.
years.h: Bass and voice, guitar, drums: Sensor Ghost starts
years.p: Dischord lists the band as active from 2019: [[Mike Andre|18f336ed-8cdb-4b22-9186-daedae20bf66]] on bass and vocals, [[Amanda Huron|be013197-fc13-439b-99a4-e5fd34f8b77c]] on guitar, Sam Lavine on drums. The label calls them a no-wave art-punk trio.
years.xp: Before any Dischord record, Sensor Ghost made a self-titled cassette on its own (catalog SG01), recorded by [[Devin Ocampo|10bc183b-b6a8-4769-9e7a-0637d0f8a7a8]] at Ivakota studio in D.C. Ocampo's own résumé runs through [[Faraquet|e866e006-4c80-4753-b53f-1bc5d88ccddd]], [[Medications|c545a7bf-c8d7-4368-8009-22e19d8911ce]] and The Effects.

eras.title: Into Inner Ear, twice
eras.text: In 2024 Sensor Ghost did what D.C. punk bands have done since 1980: went to Don Zientara's Inner Ear studio with Ian MacKaye in the room. First came a three-song single co-released by Dischord and Lovitt Records, then, in March, the session for their debut LP.

years.p: Sensor Ghost record Psychic Robots, Crystal Spa and Still Sour at Inner Ear with [[Don Zientara|a495882b-4585-4295-9269-e30c63f279fe]] and [[Ian MacKaye|c12f644b-1066-4ead-b0dd-d0c380f5cca2]]. Dischord and Lovitt Records co-release it as the follow-up to the band's cassette.
years.xp: Dischord added the single to its store on January 24, 2024; the digital version is $3.

eras.title: Irritation, on the record
eras.text: A year after the Inner Ear album session, Sensor Ghost's Irritation on Demand got Dischord No. 198, near the top of a catalog list that started with the Teen Idles in 1980.

years.p: Sensor Ghost's debut LP, eleven songs cut at Inner Ear in March 2024 with Ian MacKaye and Don Zientara, comes out a year later on translucent yellow vinyl.
years.xp:
The songs run from Plant Life to Probable Impact, with Merely Pumice, Wimpy Heart and Lamentations of the Scene along the way. In February 2025 Dischord posted the title track on Bandcamp and opened pre-orders at $20.

Dischord pitched it as the work of a band indebted to the freaked-out sonics and iconoclastic creativity of the storied D.C. punk scene.
